purpose: Predeclared RQ-11 v0.30.0 Nemotron re-anchor workload (battery and canary first, then n=5 paired anchor cells at p512/g128 and p2048/g128). Frozen before any run exists; no cell may be added, removed or re-keyed after results are seen. Scorers live in scripts/tmp/rq11_anchor_20261010.py keyed by scorer kind. This is a re-anchor of the already-validated Nemotron GPTQ-INT4 G64 + DFlash n7 route on the pinned v0.30.0 image: a new baseline, never compared to the historical 186.6 tok/s row (different 2026-08-13 harness generation).

sampling.note: greedy everywhere; measured anchor cells add ignore_eos=true and require finish_reason=length with completion_tokens exactly equal to the requested generation length

canary_channel_rule: Nemotron-3.5-Lightning is a reasoning-hybrid model; its chat template may place text in message.content and/or message.reasoning_content. The scored channel is message.content when non-empty, otherwise message.reasoning_content. Both channels are retained verbatim in raw evidence and the channel actually scored is recorded per cell. This rule was fixed here, before any run exists.

warmup.battery: one discarded warmup of the first measured battery shape (batt-arith user text, max_tokens 64) before canary run A; up to 3 attempts with health re-poll, all attempts retained
warmup.anchor: one discarded same-shape warmup per anchor shape (p512/g128 then p2048/g128) before the first measured anchor sample, each with its own unique prefix

canaries.source: prompt texts inherited verbatim from the six adoption canaries of campaigns/2026/rq17-flashnext-quality/tasks.json (decoded from /mnt/<sata-disk>/strata/prompts/batt-*.txt); the batt token-file id counts (22/20/22/28/31/26) are Qwen-tokenizer facts and are NOT asserted here - actual rendered prompt_tokens are recorded from endpoint usage instead

two_turn_8k.purpose: 8K two-turn KV-edge check on the re-anchored stack: long occupied context carried across a conversation turn (AGENTS.md section 7 cache-times-speculation shared-risk axis; prefix cache stays OFF, so both turns must record zero cache-hit delta).
two_turn_8k.turn1_prompt_source: anchors["8192"] from results/2026/10/b70-sweep-canary/prompts.json (sha256 566691fae65c6ce40aa31b19614fc40ae8adf1a286a7b33737cf9dbe4f328db9; 8192-token wikitext corpus cut with this model's served tokenizer during the 2026-10-01 v030 sweep), sent bare without a unique tag
two_turn_8k.turn1_question: Separately from the text above: what is 17 + 26? Reply with only the integer.
two_turn_8k.turn2_question: Now, going back to the long text above: what is its very first word? Reply with only that word.
two_turn_8k.turn2_expect_note: predeclared against the retained corpus before any run: the 8192-token anchor text begins with the line ' = Robert Boulter = ', so the first word carrying an alphanumeric character is 'Robert' (compared lowercased); the leading '=' tokens are not words
two_turn_8k.validity_rule: usage.prompt_tokens of turn 1 must be >= 8100 (the full 8K corpus text plus template must actually be rendered) and turn-2 occupied context (turn-2 prompt_tokens) must be >= turn-1 prompt_tokens + turn-1 completion_tokens; otherwise the cell fails measurement_validity

replay.purpose: deterministic replay smoke (correctness-validation.md deterministic_replay_smoke_tested) on the re-anchored stack; the repeated identical prompts also serve as the cache-off behavioral proof: with --no-enable-prefix-caching the /metrics prefix-cache queries and hits deltas across each replay group must both be zero
replay.gate: all three repetitions of each prompt produce the identical scored-channel text (sha256 compare, rep 1 is the reference); any mismatch is replay drift
replay.cache_gate: prefix-cache hits delta == 0 and queries delta == 0 across each 3-repetition group

anchor.purpose: RQ-11 re-anchor cells: n=5 paired samples at p512/g128 (the assessed A/A cell) and n=5 single-arm samples at p2048/g128 (secondary cell, recorded not assessed). New baseline; never compared to the historical 186.6 tok/s row.
anchor.transport: /v1/completions (raw prompt, no chat template), streaming with stream_options.include_usage for client-side token timestamps

cells.role: secondary cell, recorded in the anchor summary, not numerically assessed

anchor.order: one discarded p512-shape warmup, one discarded p2048-shape warmup, then for i in 1..5: p512-A-i, p512-B-i, p2048-i (interleaved, one client, sequential)
anchor.unique_prefix_rule: every measured or warmup anchor prompt begins with a fresh uuid4 16-hex-character tag followed by a newline (entropy-first, >= 64 chars of entropy when combined with the corpus head); tags are generated at run time and retained in raw evidence; no two requests share a prefix
anchor.exact_length_rule: prompt text = tag + newline + corpus[:n]; n is found by binary search over /tokenize counts to hit the exact declared prompt_tokens (512 or 2048) of the full rendered prompt, then re-verified once; each measured request additionally requires usage.prompt_tokens == the declared target exactly

corpus.provenance: retained wikitext-103 anchor corpus cut to exact token counts with this model's served tokenizer during the 2026-10-01 v0.30.0 sweep (results/2026/10/b70-sweep-canary/)

anchor.metrics_bracket: every request is bracketed by /metrics snapshots; recorded deltas: prefix_cache_queries, prefix_cache_hits, spec_decode drafts/accepted, num_preemptions, request_prefill/decode_time sum+count
anchor.timing_boundary: client post-first tok/s = (completion_tokens - 1) / (last - first content-delta monotonic timestamps); TTFT = first - send; TPOT = (last - first) / (completion_tokens - 1); engine-side decode rate from request_decode_time deltas retained separately as corroboration, never mixed into one column
anchor.validity_rule: a measured anchor sample is valid iff: no transport error; finish_reason == length; usage.prompt_tokens == declared target exactly; usage.completion_tokens == 128; prefix_cache_hits delta == 0; num_preemptions delta == 0. A p512 pair is valid iff both its A and B samples are valid.

cache_policy: prefix caching OFF for the whole campaign (--no-enable-prefix-caching per AGENTS.md 7 / standing-rules 1.4 on the vLLM-XPU W4A16 + speculative stack); zero-hit deltas enforced per request; the replay groups double as the resident/repeated-prefix cache-off proof
acceptance_role: DFlash acceptance counters (accepted/drafted per cell, mean accepted per round = 1 + accepted/drafted) are diagnostic only; ranking never uses them
